name: search_1_to_10mm
test_timeout_rule: 8 seconds per mm of max(training maximum radius, test case radius); minimum equals training timeout. Case radius is used only for evaluator termination, never policy input.
preparation_rule: No fault and online ready at 6s; strict 2s stability reported separately
sampling: Integer-mm grid, not continuous uniform sampling; unchanged two direction sectors. Test angles disjoint from all training angles.
large_radius_observation_note: Original own-displacement observation clips each coordinate at +/-20mm. Kept unchanged for comparability; may saturate on overshoot beyond 20mm.
